model_label: 单波段资源经验模型 v1（受限域）
validation_scope: Offline grouped synthetic validation and preregistered real-source external validation passed for stated domains; measured visible Qt event-loop path on one host, not cross-machine guarantee.
applicability_note: 正入射、单前面半无限基片、两个候选材料、单窗口非严格逐点R，无额外单层制造限制。常数无损域支持AR/HR；真实n/k域仅支持已核验SiO2/MgF2薄膜+TiO2数据集与N-BK7/熔石英基片的400–700nm AR。多窗口、均值、其他工艺和材料域不自动外推。

AR.coverage_note: 新材料组盲测：85/96项可评分，联合误差区域经验覆盖98.8%；参考流程的资源估计，不是可达证明。
AR.domain_definition: Predeclared synthetic validation sampling domain, not random empirical train extrema.
AR.reference_profile_label: 离线交替结构参考流程（非全局最小值）

HR.coverage_note: 独立材料组盲测：31/32个任务有参考见证可评分；联合区域经验覆盖率96.8%。仅为参考流程资源，不是可达证明。
HR.domain_definition: Predeclared synthetic validation sampling domain, not random empirical train extrema.
HR.reference_profile_label: 离线交替结构参考流程（非全局最小值）

real_ar_domain.coverage_note: 真实 n/k 外部核验：372/384项有参考见证可评分，层数MAE0.79层、厚度MAPE12.1%、联合区间经验覆盖99.2%；另16项新阈值核验通过。不是物理可达或统计分布外保证。
real_ar_domain.bulk_exclusion_reason: Independent bulk-as-film check has interval ratio3.108>predeclared3.0; not admitted to supported domain.

equivalent_source_validation.basis: same B coefficients, C_nm = 1e6*C_um; numerical 1001 point comparison

training_semantics: paired resources of finite independently audited reference procedures, not global minima

runtime_validation.host: AMD EPYC 9V74, Linux, 9 visible logical CPUs, offscreen Qt
runtime_validation.measurement: real Qt event loop, completion signal after independent source recheck, no Python polling
runtime_validation.caveat: Earlier Python 1ms polling artificially increased contention and is not the normal GUI baseline; cold app/material-catalog startup not included.
